reviews.author: Dr. R. K. Srivastava
reviews.comment: Furnished our consultation room and patient waiting area with Balaji Chairs. The cantilever visitor chairs and doctor's revolving chair have superb lumbar support. Extremely polite local service.

reviews.author: Sunil Verma
reviews.comment: Instead of buying cheap chairs online that break within months, we visited Balaji Chairs showroom at Daroga Bagh. The build quality of their high-back executive chair is exceptional, and they personally assembled everything.

reviews.author: Mohd. Tariq
reviews.comment: Had 15 computer lab revolving chairs repaired with new hydraulic cylinders and wheels. Saved our institute nearly 60% of replacement cost. Quick turnaround and genuine parts.

faqs.question: Do you provide office chairs in Unnao and nearby locations?
faqs.answer: Yes. Balaji Chairs is based in Anwar Market, Daroga Bagh, Civil Lines, Unnao. We provide delivery, on-site demonstration, and installation across Unnao, Shukla Ganj, and nearby Kanpur/Lucknow corridors.

faqs.question: Can I test and try chairs in person before purchasing?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You are warmly welcome to visit our showroom at 941, Anwar Market, Daroga Bagh, Civil Lines, Unnao (Monday–Saturday 10 AM to 8:30 PM) to try various ergonomic backrests, height mechanisms, and cushion densities.

faqs.question: What if my existing office chair is sinking or has broken wheels?
faqs.answer: You do not need to discard an expensive chair. We carry replacement hydraulic cylinders, heavy-duty star bases, castors, armrests, and can also re-cushion the seat. Bring it to our shop or contact us for on-site inspection.

faqs.question: Do you offer solutions for complete corporate offices and institutions?
faqs.answer: Yes. We handle end-to-end office seating projects, executive cabins, multi-person workstations, conference rooms, and institutional tables with direct B2B pricing and warranty support.

faqs.question: How do I request a quotation or check pricing?
faqs.answer: Simply tap the 'Enquire Now' button on any product page, send us a WhatsApp message directly via the website, or call us at +91 78803 53900. We will provide an instant, transparent quote with specifications.
